source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Corvette Body, p.1B-43

procedures.title: Folding top trim and rear window assembly: remove and install
steps: (continuing installation step 2) ...referring to Section A-A and figure 74 in the manual; the filler strip goes in last and locks the assembly together. Align the center marks.
If new pads are needed, fit them now, lined up with the marks made when the old ones came off (see figures 75 and 76 in the manual).
Mount the trim and rear bow assembly on the top frame with the 4 screws removed earlier.
Latch the rear bow in the desired top-up position.
Pull the stay straps up and staple or tack them to the #3 bow (see figure 77 in the manual).
Pull the trim's front edge up to the header, align center marks, smooth the fabric and temporarily clamp, tack or staple it to the header.
Draw the window extension up to the #3 bow with center marks aligned, fold plenty of fabric under and tack it to the #3 bow.
Apply neoprene trim cement (GM Part #3695016 or equivalent) to the area shown in View D of figure 71, following the package directions.
Pull the roof part of the trim over the #3 bow, align the marks and tack or staple it (printed 'tack on staple').
Cut off the extra material and fit the wire-on binding
notes: Figure 72 in the manual shows trim, weatherstrip, tacking strip, top pad and header panel at the header (View A). Figure 73 shows the rear bow retaining screws at the #3 bow; figure 74 shows fitting trim and weatherstrip with the filler to the rear bow.
